deviations_from_card: Premise re-verified after 2a5569b: Gate.tsx already fires table.acts.{phone,tidy,flag}.ids from lib/acts.ts (the planner), so the 'one module the buttons read' half already existed. remedies.ts is therefore a projection of table.acts, not a fresh derivation from phoneIds/ids/staleIds, and Gate.tsx was left untouched (dropped from write set). Consequently acceptance cases use acts.phone.ids / acts.tidy.ids (planned targets) instead of table.phoneIds / table.ids; stale uses acts.flag.ids (asserted equal to staleIds as a set). Batches are separate remedy entries with batch/batches; stale has preview:null (no dry-run tool exists); duplicate also carries pairs_hidden. plan_repairs pages are packed by a 12,000-char budget with page/pages/next_page instead of a fixed count, so the walk ends on next_page null rather than a short page. README tool list updated as the one coupled doc. ADR is 0174 (0173 taken by atlas sibling).
